description: Connect Telegram groups to Places using your connected bot on a compatible Ouroboros, or use a separate bot for groups, channels, and private chats people open with it. Both group paths support topics and durable media delivery. The Bot API cannot read earlier history.
name: telegram-bot
needs: On a compatible Ouroboros, your connected bot needs no new token. A separate bot needs its own token.
pitch: People and groups talk to it there
title: Telegram for others
